value:
THE RUN-41 DEMAND TABLE FOR THE SHIPPED COMPOSED CLASS (equivalent_copy_form + instruction_permutation + copy_register_fields), with a MEASURED VERDICT and an INSTRUMENTED REFUSAL for every row rather than a candidate list. Nine unpinned, index-aligned functions hold a copy-form-decodable word pair; all nine REFUSE today, and the refusals split into two mechanisms with different next steps. AGENTS.md discipline 14 applies to every line below: these are measurements of the guard as much as of the function.

GROUP A -- IMMEDIATE DIVERGENCE, structurally outside EVERY postprocessor class (the same wall as count asymmetry, reached from the other side). The form stage refuses at 'non-register instruction bits differ' on a word whose two halves carry different literals, so no recolor, permutation or value proof can ever close them and no capability request should be filed:
  game/mb/mb_camera::MBCameraUpdate (159 insns, 18 words) -- +0x1e4 ours `addi r9,r9,16` (39290010) against the target's `addi r4,r4,4` (38840004); refusal `non-register instruction bits differ at +0x1e4: 0x01ad0014`. THIS REFUTES A LIVE WORK ORDER: work_claim.tier2-finish.20260903.v1 instructs its lane to file a rule-request record 'if the rotation words are value-equal scratch shapes'. They are not -- one of the 18 is a displacement difference of 16 against 4, which is a source-level addressing fact and not an allocator choice.
  game/world/world::WorldSaveInitState (111, 31) -- +0x64 ours `addi r12,r31,232` (399f00e8) against `addi r5,r29,0` (38bd0000); `+0x64: 0x012200e8`.
  game/sys/cardutil::cardDoWrite (263, 46) -- +0x3b8 ours `addi r8,r8,-2` (3908fffe) against `addi r3,r3,-4` (3863fffc); `+0x3b8: 0x016b0002`.
  game/pb/pb_diag::pbDiagDrawSoundRow (283, 73) -- +0x134 ours `addi r8,r8,1` (39080001) against `addi r3,r3,292` (38630124); `+0x134: 0x016b0125`.

GROUP B -- verify_consistent_recolor refuses at a NAMED position. These are live candidates for the permutation-repair shape that closed game/world/tower::TowerCheckMessages (transpose the two definitions upstream of the merge, then the SAME recolor is a clean bijection), or for a proved `value_equality_recolor`. The refusal offset is a POINTER TO THE MERGE, not a verdict on the function:
  game/world/tower::towerRecordLevelBeaten (79 insns, 25 words) -- `+0x20: use of g30 does not correspond to g31 under the running renaming`. THIS EXECUTES A PREDICTION THAT HAD NEVER BEEN RUN: attempt.NM_towerrecordlevelbeaten-store-order-and-decl-order-are-both-unreachable.20260902.v1 recorded that claim.RC_block-rotation-population-census-run-39.20260902.v1's 80.0% best-fit assignment 'predicts the strict proof REFUSES; that prediction has NOT been executed against verify_consistent_recolor'. It is now executed and CONFIRMED, and the refusal names the exact word.
  game/sys/memcard::drawMemCardMessage (204, 61) -- `+0x84: use of g26 does not correspond to g22 under the running renaming`.
  game/ui/attract::scroll_credits (148, 52) -- `+0xe4: base register presence differs (g25 vs g0)`, a different check from the other four: our word and the target's disagree about whether a base register is present at all.
  game/game/player::PlayerProcessPowerups (1598, 24) -- `+0xe68: use of f1 does not correspond to f1 under the running renaming` (an FPR merge, and the smallest word count in the whole table relative to its size). TU claimed this run by work_claim.powerups-finish.20260903.v1.
  game/enemy/enemy::do_enemies (568, 172) -- `+0x738: use of f0 does not correspond to f26 under the running renaming`.

OWNERSHIP, checked with `gdlmem claims` at measurement time: MBCameraUpdate and PlayerProcessPowerups sit in TUs claimed by other run-41 lanes (CL and SA), so both rows are published as MEASUREMENTS ONLY and no rule was authored for either; pbDiagDrawSoundRow sits in this lane's own TU and is refuted as ineligible rather than parked for a rule. The remaining five are unclaimed.

HOW TO REPRODUCE ANY ROW IN ONE COMMAND: `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wz_try_compose.py game/world/tower::towerRecordLevelBeaten`. That is the point of publishing refusal strings instead of a candidate list -- a row whose stated symptom no longer exists announces itself immediately.
